uncited: In NeRF-based implementations, this is the output of the volume rendering equation [44-radiance-field-optimization.md].
Render or compute the radiation field $F(\mathbf{x}, t)$ for all spatial points $\mathbf{x}$ and all time steps $t=1 \dots T$.
Compute the difference vector $\Delta_t = F(\mathbf{x}, t+1) - F(\mathbf{x}, t)$.
Sum the norms and divide by $T-1$ to obtain the average temporal difference.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Requires storing or re-computing the radiation fields for $T$ frames.
